answer_1.quote: Our goal is to generate a relevant and non-generic response when given an unseen prompt. ... We conduct experiments on two datasets: PersonaChat and DailyDialog.

answer_2.quote: We also include the results of the following automatic metrics for reference in Table: (1) BLEU-1 and BLEU-2 ... (2) Embedding Average cosine similarity ... (3) dist-1 and dist-2 ...

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation is the only reliable way to evaluate this task. ... for each model, we randomly sample 500 pairs from our test set, and each pair is rated by 3 distinct crowdsourcing workers. We ask them to rate 1) informativeness and specificity of each response and 2) if the response is on topic (relevance), on a Likert scale from 0 to 3.
answer_4.guideline: Crowdsourced workers rate each generated response on informativeness, specificity, and relevance using a 0‑3 Likert scale.
